    Aspose.Cells FOSS - Public API Documentation Generation

    Overview

    A complete documentation generation system has been implemented for Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET. The system automatically generates professional HTML and CHM documentation from XML comments in the source code.

    Quick Start

    1. Generate Documentation (Windows - Recommended)

    cd documentation
BuildDocumentation.bat

    2. Generate Documentation (Cross-platform)

    cd documentation
dotnet run -- --metadata

    3. View Documentation

    cd documentation
dotnet run -- --serve

    Then open http://localhost:8080

    4. Generate CHM File (Windows only)

    cd documentation
.\GenerateChm.ps1

    What You Get

    • ✅ HTML Documentation - Professional API reference with navigation
    • ✅ CHM Help File - Standalone Windows help file with search
    • ✅ API Reference - Complete documentation for all public APIs
    • ✅ Code Examples - Integrated examples from source code
    • ✅ Search Functionality - Full-text search in both formats

    Requirements

    Required

    • .NET SDK 8.0 or later
    • DocFX (automatically restored via NuGet)

    Optional (for CHM generation)

    • HTML Help Workshop
      • Download from: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=21138

    Documentation Structure

    documentation/
├── Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Documentation.csproj  # Project file
├── Program.cs                               # Documentation generator
├── DocumentationValidator.cs               # Setup validator
├── docfx.json                               # DocFX configuration
├── toc.yml                                  # Table of contents
├── index.md                                 # Main landing page
├── README.md                                # Full documentation
├── QUICKSTART.md                            # Quick start guide
├── SETUP.md                                 # Setup status
├── IMPLEMENTATION.md                        # Implementation details
├── BuildDocumentation.bat                   # Windows build script
├── GenerateChm.ps1                          # CHM generation script
└── _site/                                   # Generated output (gitignored)
    ├── index.html                           # Main HTML page
    ├── api/                                 # API reference
    └── chm/                                 # CHM files

    How It Works

    The Process

    1. Build Main Project - Generates XML documentation files
    2. Run DocFX Metadata - Extracts API information from XML
    3. Run DocFX Build - Generates HTML documentation
    4. Generate CHM (optional) - Compiles CHM help file

    Input Sources

    • XML documentation comments in C# source code
    • DocFX configuration files
    • Markdown documentation files

    Output Formats

    • HTML documentation (cross-platform)
    • CHM help file (Windows only)

    Customization

    Modify Main Page

    Edit documentation/index.md to change the landing page content.

    Change Navigation

    Edit documentation/toc.yml to modify the table of contents structure.

    Enhance API Documentation

    Add XML comments to source code:

    /// <summary>
/// Gets or sets the cell value.
/// </summary>
/// <example>
/// <code>
/// cell.PutValue("Hello");
/// </code>
/// </example>
public object Value { get; set; }

    Configure DocFX

    Edit documentation/docfx.json to change:

    • Output destinations
    • Global metadata
    • Build options
    • XRef settings

    Integration

    CI/CD Pipeline

    # Example for GitHub Actions
- name: Generate Documentation
  run: |
    cd documentation
    dotnet run -- --metadata

- name: Deploy Documentation
  uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
  with:
    github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    publish_dir: ./documentation/_site

    Pre-commit Hook

    #!/bin/bash
# Generate documentation on commit
cd documentation
dotnet run -- --metadata

    Validation

    Check Setup

    cd documentation
dotnet run -- validate

    Verify Generated Files

    Check documentation/_site/ for generated HTML files.

    Troubleshooting

    Common Issues

    Build fails with "XML documentation not found"

    • Ensure main project is built: dotnet build src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj
    • Check GenerateDocumentationFile property in .csproj file

    DocFX not found

    • Install globally: dotnet tool install -g docfx
    • Or restore NuGet packages: dotnet restore

    CHM generation fails

    • Install HTML Help Workshop
    • Verify hhc.exe is in expected location
    • Check HTML files are generated before CHM compilation

    Missing API documentation

    • Add XML comments to public APIs
    • Rebuild main project
    • Regenerate documentation

    Performance

    • Build Time: ~2-5 minutes for full documentation
    • HTML Size: ~10-50 MB depending on API surface
    • CHM Size: ~5-20 MB compressed
    • Incremental Builds: Supported by DocFX

    Maintenance

    Regular Tasks

    • Update DocFX version in .csproj
    • Review and improve XML comments
    • Update documentation examples
    • Check generated documentation quality

    Version Updates

    1. Update DocFX package version
    2. Test documentation generation
    3. Verify output quality
    4. Update scripts if needed
